footer.note: Deadlines use Tashkent time (UTC+5). Support after the event is not promised.

home.title: Build a working project. Defend it in public.
home.lead: MU Hackathon takes a student team from a clear problem to a working MVP. Twenty teams continue after the application. Twelve reach the offline final.
home.step1Body: Seven days to describe the problem, the user, and the solution.
home.step2Body: Fourteen days to ship a working product and the materials around it.
home.step3Body: Twelve teams, five minutes each, in front of five experts.
